design_criterion_verbatim: Chain PASS if the three identities hold to 1e-6 (predicted FAIL on thermal-vs-acoustics - report, don't fix). Observability: every material effect >= 1e5 below its floor (predicted 5-9 orders); clocks are the only channel and S9a has closed it. No thesis weight.

rho: Bartl et al. 2017 Metrologia 54, 693: N_A by XRCD to 1.2e-8 (sphere density/volume limited); NMIJ sphere density 2320.070841(76) kg/m3 = 3.3e-8

Theta_D: DERIVED from LIT: Theta_D proportional to v_D at fixed n; same pulse-echo floor
T_melt: DERIVED from LIT: NIST, 13 Ga melting-point cells span 0.04 mK at 302.9146 K
c_p: LIT: adiabatic calorimetry of Cu agrees with references to 0.1 % (Stevens & Boerio-Goates 2004, J. Chem. Thermodyn., doi 10.1016/j.jct.2004.06.008)

sigma_increments: Delta sigma per km = 2 xi g (1 km)/c^2 and Delta sigma annual amplitude = 2 xi e r_s,sun/(2a); field-equation normalisation sigma = -2 xi Phi/c^2 as headline, inventory normalisation (x1/2) also reported
